title: anthemis carpatica var. macedonica
intro: Anthemis carpatica var. macedonica, commonly known as Macedonian Chamomile, is a plant species within the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote a good night's sleep. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis carpatica var. macedonica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
